lines.text: Every morning... your developers open Claude Code, or Cursor. And every single morning? The agent has forgotten your company.
So someone explains it all... again. The service boundaries. The naming rules. The why. And then? It forgets. All of it.
The obvious fix? Put the memory in a vendor's cloud. But security won't sign that. Three out of eight engineering leaders, in one room, told me exactly this.
This is Holt Teams! One shared memory, for every agent on your team. And it never, ever leaves your servers.
Here's how it works. A decision gets written once... and every teammate's agent recalls it. Claude Code. Cursor. Codex. All inside your network. Nothing is sent to us. Ever.
Memory is stored as small, single facts. Each one knows its scope, how often it's been seen... and exactly what it replaced.
Your store can grow to millions of facts. But what goes into each prompt? About six thousand tokens. Every single time.
Agents only touch the folders you trust. Every read is logged. So your security team can see it for themselves... no need to take our word for it.
The memory engine? Open source, and shipping today. The team layer... we build with you.
Three founding teams. Twelve weeks. And the first thirty days? No licence fee.
If your agents forget your company every morning... become a founding team. Holt Teams. Let's build it together.
